name: ISO/IEC 23894:2023 AI Risk Management Guidance
disclaimer: Academic reference and mapping crosswalk for ISO/IEC 23894 risk management guidelines. Not an official ISO conformity assessment.

controls.title: AI Risk Identification and Threat Modeling
controls.description: Systematically identify risks specific to AI, including prompt injection, model degradation, training contamination, and excessive autonomy.
controls.verification_guidance: Check for threat modeling artifacts identifying GenAI assets, trust boundaries, agent permissions, and threat vectors.

controls.title: AI Risk Treatment and Technical Guardrails
controls.description: Implement technical and operational controls to mitigate identified AI risks to an acceptable level.
controls.verification_guidance: Examine implementation of input filters, output validators, rate limits, and least-privilege tool execution.

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring and Feedback Loops
controls.description: Continuously monitor AI system outputs, operational metrics, and user feedback to detect drift or emerging security vulnerabilities.
controls.verification_guidance: Verify runtime logging of prompt execution times, hallucination rate telemetry, and feedback capture mechanisms.
